title: Great app but math section needs more options!
body:
The math puzzles you have to solve before the alarm ends is great, and you can choose both how many puzzles and how hard they are. You can see your math skills developing really fast, and it REALLY wakes you up!

The problem is that I can’t completely decide what kind of math puzzles I get. I would want to solve something like 63*48 etc., but I can’t get multiplication without addition so for example hard mode is XX*XX+XXX instead of just XX*XX. Please fix that so I can systematically choose which math skills to develop. 

Also choosing the range of numbers would be needed, like multiplication with numbers from 10 to 40 or whatever I choose to choose. Aaand it would make a LOT of sense to be able to do subtractions and divisions too.

This would improve the quality dramatically, and I’m sure that it would bring tons of new customers.

Other than that the app is great!

Btw it’s pretty funny that I could choose to have to solve NINETY-NINE puzzles in the form of XXX*XX+XXXX 😂 What a way to wake up every morning.
